chapter: Massey Hall, race and the record business
title: Dizzy pulls a knife on Mingus after Massey Hall
summary: Dizzy resented Mingus getting a solo and pulled a knife; Mingus found the fire ax; similar scene with Juan Tizol.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: Yeah, I went backstage, (inaudible) "I can blow better than you. Why did you give me a solo?" Pulled a knife. Of course, I saw the fire ax. It was lucky I heard about him cutting Cab Calloway; so I found out where the fire ax was. Because he didn't pull his knife (inaudible). (Inaudible). I had a similar experience with Juan Tizol of the Duke's band.
Wonderful story. And you had a fire ax then, as a matter of fact.
Always looked for the fire ax. (Laughter.)
Charles Mingus' advice to young concert performers. First thing you do is check out the acoustics in the hall, and then find the fire ax.
